correction_note: V4 changes producer slab-status aggregation key paths only; arithmetic settings are identical to v3.
integer_output_policy: All state/range endpoints are dyadic-grid rationals; exact scalar tail arithmetic is bounded by (bits+8)*(degree+2)+8*(degree+2) <= rational_bit_cap before execution. Serialization remains bounded by the declared rational bit cap.
outward_rounding: after every interval endpoint construction, round lower down and upper up to multiples of 2^-96 using exact integer division
parameter_policy: same complete exact label cell and label order reused unchanged on every slab; no parameter subdivision or reset
partial_slab_policy: enclose exp(A*tau) for all tau in [0,h] by interval Taylor terms and an outward symmetric norm tail; endpoint uses tau=h and carries the resulting interval to the next slab
unknown_policy: return UNKNOWN or RESOURCE_UNKNOWN on failed branch, margin, arithmetic cap, wall limit, memory limit, output cap, or unsupported input; preserve row and reason
